heroText: A space by the sea to move, breathe and take a moment for yourself. Discover Mandala Yoga Santa Pola.
aboutTitle: A place to breathe and reconnect
aboutText: Mandala Yoga is located right by the seafront in Santa Pola. Practice helps you listen to your body and take a break from everyday life.
class1Text: Postures and breathing at a measured pace, with time to observe movement, balance and how your body feels.
class2Text: More fluid sequences where breathing accompanies the transition between postures. Ask about current classes.
class3Text: Gentle movements and body awareness. This practice appears in a timetable shared by the centre; confirm current sessions.

communityText: Images shared by Mandala Yoga show practice on the beach and in the studio. Ask about upcoming activities.
a1: Yes, there are classes for beginners and experienced practitioners.

aboutExtra: Practice can be a starting point for someone new to yoga or a way to maintain a personal routine. Each session gives you dedicated time to move, breathe and slow down.
practiceTitle: A practice at your own pace
practiceIntro: In Santa Pola, close to the Mediterranean, Mandala Yoga gives you an opportunity to pause and make time for movement. The practices have different rhythms: in some, you stay in a posture and notice your breath; in others, the movements flow into one another.
practiceHatha: Hatha Yoga combines postures, breathing and concentration. Its slower pace helps you observe body alignment and transitions, whether you are just starting or already practise regularly. Some people want to improve mobility; others hope to release the day’s tension or simply find a quiet moment.
practiceTaiChi: Tai Chi is also available at the centre. Its slow, precise movements link together to develop coordination, balance and continuity. Hatha Yoga invites you to explore each posture in depth, while Tai Chi focuses more on the flow of movement.
practiceVinyasa: Vinyasa is a more dynamic form of yoga in which breathing accompanies the transitions between postures.
